error.deviceRevoked: This device has been revoked. Online login required.
error.offlineExpired: Offline login window expired. Online login required.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

logout.label: Sign out
logout.confirm: Do you want to sign out?

expired.title: Session expired
expired.message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

idleLocked.title: Session locked
idleLocked.message: Your session is locked due to inactivity.

forcePasswordChange.title: Password change required
forcePasswordChange.message: You must set a new password before continuing.

pin.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please use your password.

stepUp.title: Identity confirmation required
stepUp.message: This is a sensitive action. Enter your password to confirm.

device.revokeConfirm: Offline access for this device will be removed. Continue?

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.message: You do not have the necessary permissions to access this page. Ask an administrator to update your role.

lockout.title: Account Locked
lockout.message: Account temporarily locked. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
lockout.adminUnlock: Contact an administrator to unlock your account.

vendorLogin.title: Vendor console
vendorLogin.subtitle: Sign in with your control-plane account.
vendorLogin.apiUnreachable: The control API could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.intro: Every sign-in to this console needs a code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS…). Scan this QR code with it.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app instead:

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now: print them or save the file somewhere safe, away from your phone.
recovery.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the codes and copy them by hand.
recovery.fileHeader: Maintafox vendor console — recovery codes (each works once)
recovery.ack: I have saved these codes somewhere safe.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
verify.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your recovery codes. It will stop working once used.

recoveryUsed.title: Signed in with a recovery code
recoveryUsed.body_one: You have {{count}} recovery code left. Generate new ones from the account menu (top right).
recoveryUsed.body_other: You have {{count}} recovery codes left. Generate new ones from the account menu (top right) if few remain.

error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
error.invalid_mfa_code: Code refused. Check the phone's time, or wait for the next code (a code works only once).
error.invalid_recovery_code: This recovery code is not valid or was already used.
error.mfa_token_invalid: This step took too long. Sign in again.
error.mfa_enrollment_required: Two-step verification was reset. Sign in again to set it up.
error.mfa_already_enrolled: Two-step verification is already set up for this account. Sign in again.
error.network: The control API could not be reached. Check your connection.
error.invalid_reset_code: This reset code is not valid. Use the code printed by the reset command (or ask for a new reset).

resetCode.title: Enter your reset code
resetCode.intro: Two-step verification was reset on the server. Enter the one-time reset code you were given with the reset, then set up your authenticator app again.
resetCode.label: Reset code
